response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong technical expertise and a diverse background in software development, including AI-agent infrastructure and cloud technologies. While his experience aligns well with the technical requirements, his leadership and strategic AI contributions are less explicitly highlighted, warranting a closer evaluation during an interview.
strengths: Extensive experience (15+ years) in software development across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems, including cloud and AI-related projects.
Proven track record in building and contributing to open-source platforms (e.g., GISCollective) and AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators).
Strong entrepreneurial mindset with experience founding and maintaining a geo-data platform used by NGOs and conservation scientists.
concerns: Lacks an advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in an AI-related field, which is a preferred qualification.
Limited explicit evidence of director-level strategic leadership or advising external partners on AI/cloud adoption.
Experience in AI appears more tactical (e.g., tooling) rather than strategic (e.g., shaping AI product roadmaps or differentiation).
